entries.title: Isaiah 41:1
segments: ¶"Keep silence before Me, O coastlands, And let the people renew [their] strength! Let them come near, then let them speak; Let us come near together for judgment.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:2
segments: "Who raised up one from the east? Who in righteousness called him to His feet? Who gave the nations before him, And made [him] rule over kings? Who gave [them] as the dust [to] his sword, As driven stubble to his bow?

entries.title: Isaiah 41:3
segments: Who pursued them, [and] passed safely By the way [that] he had not gone with his feet?

entries.title: Isaiah 41:4
segments: Who has performed and done [it], Calling the generations from the beginning? 'I, the LORD, am the first; And with the last I [am] He.'"

entries.title: Isaiah 41:5
segments: The coastlands saw [it] and feared, The ends of the earth were afraid; They drew near and came.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:6
segments: Everyone helped his neighbor, And said to his brother, "Be of good courage!"

entries.title: Isaiah 41:7
segments: So the craftsman encouraged the goldsmith; He who smooths [with] the hammer [inspired] him who strikes the anvil, Saying, "It [is] ready for the soldering"; Then he fastened it with pegs, [That] it might not totter.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:8
segments: "But you, Israel, [are] My servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, The descendants of Abraham My friend.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:9
segments: [You] whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, And called from its farthest regions, And said to you, 'You [are] My servant, I have chosen you and have not cast you away:

entries.title: Isaiah 41:10
segments: ¶Fear not, for I [am] with you; Be not dismayed, for I [am] your God. I will strengthen you, Yes, I will help you, I will uphold you with My righteous right hand.'

entries.title: Isaiah 41:11
segments: "Behold, all those who were incensed against you Shall be ashamed and disgraced; They shall be as nothing, And those who strive with you shall perish.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:12
segments: You shall seek them and not find them-Those who contended with you. Those who war against you Shall be as nothing, As a nonexistent thing.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:13
segments: For I, the LORD your God, will hold your right hand, Saying to you, 'Fear not, I will help you.'

entries.title: Isaiah 41:14
segments: "Fear not, you worm Jacob, You men of Israel! I will help you," says the LORD And your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:15
segments: "Behold, I will make you into a new threshing sledge with sharp teeth; You shall thresh the mountains and beat [them] small, And make the hills like chaff.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:16
segments: You shall winnow them, the wind shall carry them away, And the whirlwind shall scatter them; You shall rejoice in the LORD, [And] glory in the Holy One of Israel.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:17
segments: "The poor and needy seek water, but [there is] none, Their tongues fail for thirst. I, the LORD, will hear them; [I], the God of Israel, will not forsake them.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:18
segments: I will open rivers in desolate heights, And fountains in the midst of the valleys; I will make the wilderness a pool of water, And the dry land springs of water.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:19
segments: I will plant in the wilderness the cedar and the acacia tree, The myrtle and the oil tree; I will set in the desert the cypress tree [and] the pine And the box tree together,

entries.title: Isaiah 41:20
segments: That they may see and know, And consider and understand together, That the hand of the LORD has done this, And the Holy One of Israel has created it.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:21
segments: ¶"Present your case," says the LORD. "Bring forth your strong [reasons]," says the King of Jacob.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:22
segments: "Let them bring forth and show us what will happen; Let them show the former things, what they [were], That we may consider them, And know the latter end of them; Or declare to us things to come.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:23
segments: Show the things that are to come hereafter, That we may know that you [are] gods; Yes, do good or do evil, That we may be dismayed and see [it] together.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:24
segments: Indeed you [are] nothing, And your work [is] nothing; [He who] chooses you [is] an abomination.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:25
segments: "I have raised up one from the north, And he shall come; From the rising of the sun he shall call on My name; And he shall come against princes as [though] mortar, As the potter treads clay.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:26
segments: Who has declared from the beginning, that we may know? And former times, that we may say, '[He is] righteous'? Surely [there is] no one who shows, Surely [there is]  no one who declares, Surely [there is] no one who hears your words.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:27
segments: The first time [I said] to Zion, 'Look, there they are!' And I will give to Jerusalem one who brings good tidings.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:28
segments: For I looked, and [there was] no man; I looked among them, but [there was] no counselor, Who, when I asked of them, could answer a word.

entries.title: Isaiah 41:29
segments: Indeed they [are] all worthless; Their works [are] nothing; Their molded images [are] wind and confusion.
